'''Narp Pilyev''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who worked as a bureaucrat for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Pilyev lived in an [[Narp Pilyev's apartment|apartment]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and owned two [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], which he used as security guards. He stole some valuable [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] documents and attempted to sell them to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Draba]], telling her that he would offer them to another buyer if she didn't match his price within five days. However, Draba instead hired some agents to break into Pilyev's apartment and steal the documents.<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
